reasons: Only visible candidate; cannot satisfy portfolio-level non-repetition.
Mass reads as a generic stepped bar with a void rather than a clearly program-specific mixed-use street building.
Street edge and public threshold are too weak relative to the compact capacity-aware intent.

rationale: The sheet contains only one visible candidate card, so it cannot function as a 20-candidate portfolio audit and cannot demonstrate the required anti-repetition rules. The single mass is a readable voided bar, but it does not yet establish a strong program-specific ground threshold or enough sectional differentiation to stand as a portfolio anchor. The next run should diversify the family set while keeping the active street edge and usable public void/terrace as the shared program logic.

repeated_family_groups.shared_language: single voided bar/courtyard chassis with recursive stepped massing; only one visible candidate so no portfolio differentiation can be demonstrated

required_next_relations: Introduce at least 3 materially different massing families across the set: one courtyard-based street building, one notch/lift variant, and one split-wing or attached-volume variant.
Preserve an active west street edge while making the public void/terrace clearly usable, not merely sculptural.
Differentiate roof and section logic across candidates so no two cards share the same bar/roof chassis.
Use distinct access-and-void relations: carve, lift, split, or terrace should each produce a different spatial sequence.
Keep upper mass calm and secondary to the ground program, but vary how the upper body is displaced or trimmed.
